items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: During that time, Bill was with Papa Sellers, they in the big band.

ctx.x: During that time, Bill was with Papa Sellers, they in the big band.
Did you hear many piano players then?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Was it Celestan? No, Celestan wasn't, give up Eddie Jackson, had the band then.

ctx.x: Because I don't know much about them.

Well George was, he worked in the band, and I was leading that band. Was it Celestan? No, Celestan wasn't, give up Eddie Jackson, had the band then. Eddie Jackson, one of the best tuba that we all know ever lived.
